items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: Frank and his brother, they made me save some, they taught me to save.

ctx.x: So that was something to get down there, then?

Yes. I was, I saved so much money. I was young. I didn't know what to do with it. And Frank and his brother, they made me save some, they taught me to save. And my mother was sick at the time. And I had to send my salary home and keep my tips. Was that good? The tips, the salary was nothing next to the tips because the salary was $2.50 a day from 7 to 5 in the morning. That's $2.50. I was getting five pesos a day at that time. But we didn't make twice that much or much more than that on tips. Oh, yeah. So I'd…
What was the name of that joint? Frank?
